import subprocess, json
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/lifecycle-ci-20261007")
branch="feat/ci-wait-lifecycle-20261007"
head_expected="65f9a3e792c3cf3fa951df21fe9114a180d85d40"
main_expected="78d826e019428c1f1b0d98acf45f3c16812ae61a"

def run(args, check=True):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)
    return p

if run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()!=head_expected:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected feature head")
if run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()!=branch:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected branch")
if run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip():
    raise SystemExit("feature worktree not clean")

f=run(["git","fetch","origin","main"],check=False)
print(f.stdout); print(f.stderr)
if f.returncode: raise SystemExit(f.returncode)
main=run(["git","rev-parse","origin/main"]).stdout.strip()
print("origin_main="+main)
if main!=main_expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"main advanced again: {main}")

print("=== merge-base ===")
print(run(["git","merge-base","HEAD","origin/main"]).stdout.strip())

print("=== commits feature-only ===")
print(run(["git","log","--oneline","origin/main..HEAD"]).stdout)

print("=== commits main-only ===")
print(run(["git","log","--oneline","HEAD..origin/main"]).stdout)

print("=== changed files feature vs main ===")
print(run(["git","diff","--name-status","origin/main...HEAD"]).stdout)

print("=== direct content diff main -> feature ===")
d=run(["git","diff","--stat","origin/main","HEAD"],check=False)
print(d.stdout)
print(run(["git","diff","--unified=35","origin/main","HEAD","--",
           "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
           "src/do_again/service/liveness.py",
           "tests/test_liveness.py",
           "tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"],check=False).stdout)

print("=== current main lifecycle symbols ===")
for rel in ["src/do_again/core/schema.py","src/do_again/service/liveness.py","tests/test_liveness.py","tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"]:
    txt=run(["git","show",f"origin/main:{rel}"],check=False)
    print(f"--- {rel} rc={txt.returncode} ---")
    if txt.returncode==0:
        lines=txt.stdout.splitlines()
        for i,line in enumerate(lines):
            low=line.lower()
            if any(k in low for k in [
                "waiting_for_ci","ci_terminal","goal_state","handoff",
                "actions/runs","validated_complete","waiting_for_execution",
                "unacknowledged","uncertain"
            ]):
                a=max(0,i-4); b=min(len(lines),i+10)
                for j in range(a,b):
                    print(f"{j+1}: {lines[j]}")
                print()

print("=== patch-id comparison ===")
for rev in ["HEAD","5769ed24e39c66fb1f124157c8d5bb4503bfb7f1"]:
    p=run(["git","show",rev,"--pretty=format:","--no-ext-diff"],check=False)
    q=subprocess.run(["git","patch-id","--stable"],cwd=wt,input=p.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True)
    print(rev, q.stdout.strip())

print("READ_ONLY_SUPERSESSION_AUDIT_COMPLETE")
